proposed_contract.initial_scope: Only trusted selected10.0.7 ordinary native whole/partial routing, source_all layers, existing standard transport. proposed_contract.closure: Exact captured relative SCH bytes; resolve only canonical in-project Sheetfile paths, enumerate instances (not unique files). Refuse abs/..,variables,symlinks,case aliases,cycles,missing children,ambiguous project blocks and structural directives outside paired closure. Initial limits16SCH/64instances/depth8 within existing100MiB/2000files/512components/4096terminals.
proposed_contract.instance_key: (root UUID,ordered sheet UUID path,symbol UUID,unit). Match the one project name/root stem and exact full instances.project.path/reference/unit. Group units only for same instance+final reference+resolved embedded definition. Repeated child UUIDs require distinct proven paths; refs/units/UUID aliases refuse.
proposed_contract.units: Exact lib_id or explicit lib_name resolves one embedded definition; exported libsource agrees. Initially unit1 or units1+2 only. Common0+unit pin sets must match exported A/B membership; all drawing styles must have equal pin sets (no guessed convert default). Only common0-proven duplicates collapse. Bind all stamp atoms in unit order and PCB primary unit1 path. Explicit embedded(power)+empty footprint+export absence qualifies power-only instances; # names alone do not.
proposed_contract.terminals: Exact source path/footprint UUID/pin strings join connected PCB pads to complete SCH terminal partitions/net labels. Connected(ref,pin) unique; shared common pins form one physical terminal. Extra original no-net pads must be absent from library/export pin union; retain exact UUID/number/type/parent/geometry/netlessness, including duplicate MP. Missing connected pins or newly connected extras refuse.
proposed_contract.classes: Require original PRO qualify_project mode single_default; every joined SCH and Native PCB class must be exact Default. Bind each Native four-dimension scalar/parameter parent to the unchanged original Default value and priority. Class identity is distinct from board minimum-rule resolution. Do not call the parent/composite floor-target audit and weaken it to make this pass.
proposed_contract.proof: Bind all closure/board/PRO/netlist/map hashes and per-instance/unit/terminal/no-net matrix to exact policy/version/tools. Pure derive is never acceptance. Stage collection/replay rederives source and exact worker/output/PRL bindings; no receipt-selected support/policy/paths.
